title: Towards a universal language of concepts: A survey
abstract: arXiv:2609.04528v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Humans can learn and generalize novel concepts from sparse data because they express knowledge in rich structural formats. In this paper, we propose that programs are a strong candidate for universal representation of concepts. We review computational models of concept learning that use programs as their concept representation and evaluate their contribution toward a universal representational language.

translated_title: 迈向概念的通用语言：一篇综述
translated_abstract: 人类能够从稀疏数据中学习并泛化新概念，是因为他们以丰富的结构化格式来表达知识。在本文中，我们提出程序是概念通用表示的一个有力候选。我们回顾了以程序作为概念表示的概念学习计算模型，并评估了它们对构建通用表示语言的贡献。
tldr: 本文综述了以程序作为概念表示的概念学习计算模型，并提出程序有望成为人类概念的通用表示语言。
en_tdlr: This survey reviews computational models of concept learning that use programs as concept representations, proposing that programs are a strong candidate for a universal language of concepts.
